scope: Only the 40 written questions in the current pack; stable IDs and tier counts preserved.
method: Replaced all generic Wikiquote/Wikisource and whole-book PDF links with opened book passages or precise chapters. Classical collections are direct witnesses of the recorded proverbs. Modern literary texts and transcribed speech are direct witnesses of their wording, not proof of original authorship or earliest date. No story of origin, medical claim or legal judgment is asked.
limits: No empirical player calibration. Difficulty targets remain editorial estimates.
No claim that the source hosting mirrors are original publishers or manuscript facsimiles. Islamport and Islamicbook reproduce named historical books; Hindawi/Safahat provides edited literary texts.
Some attempted Islamport pages failed with Unicode decoding errors or access errors; they were not retained. The inaccessible Wikisource stub and generic Wikiquote aggregate are not evidence.
The sayings الحاجة أم الاختراع and آخر الدواء الكي may be easier than their assigned tiers for many groups. Source verification alone cannot establish the intended success rates.
